transcript.text: My Hotpoint washer dryer isn't drying properly any more and there's a funny smell when it's on the dry bit. Is there something I should clean?

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning smell or smoke can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using the machine, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't use it again until it has been checked by a qualified engineer.
